recommendation: Keep the source fix. Further work is only needed if the work group separately decides to revisit the List.entry.deleted date/choice question noted in the May 2022 minutes.
issue_request: FHIR-34442 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core List. It asked to remove the lst-3 rule that List.entry.date only be used on working lists, or otherwise remove lst-2 so deleted entries could be used on working lists. The final resolution drops both lst-2 and lst-3 and adds guidance that deleted must be used for deleted entries in change lists while working and snapshot lists may either flag or remove deleted items.
initial_application: Commit f2d052d53225a3fca4e58c306f438e82047d9eab removed lst-2 and lst-3 from source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml and added the deleted-flag guidance to source/list/list-notes.xml. Current source already permits List.entry.date outside working lists and List.entry.deleted outside changes lists, but the added note used the non-existent code `change` instead of `changes`.
additional_context: The May 2022 FHIR-I WGM minutes confirm the decision to remove lst-2 and lst-3 with a Rick Geimer/Yunwei Wang 19-0-2 motion. The March 2022 FHIR-I minutes identify FHIR-13986 and FHIR-27083 as related background: FHIR-13986 was the earlier date constraint decision and FHIR-27083 clarified List/Group boundaries without changing this reconciliation scope. source/fhir.ini lists List as an active resource, so source/list/list-notes.xml is in current build scope.
reconciliation: Changed source/list/list-notes.xml so the deleted-flag guidance says `mode = changes` instead of `mode = change`. No other source changes were needed because the structural invariants were already removed.
source_changes: source/list/list-notes.xml: corrected the deleted-flag guidance from List.mode = change to the defined List.mode = changes.
